jobs.title: Senior Energy Analyst
jobs.description:
About us

Gridcog is a global SaaS start-up of energy nerds on a mission to accelerate investment in the clean energy transition. We build project modelling software that captures the physical and commercial detail of energy projects, front-of-meter and behind the meter, so our users can make intelligent energy decisions. Our clients have modelled over 17k projects in over 40 markets globally.

Germany is one of our most important markets. We've built a strong brand here and work with some of the most active developers, IPPs and energy companies in the country, including MaxSolar, Lintas, Suncatcher, Octopus Energy Generation, TotalEnergies and Shell.

Who we're looking for

We're looking for a Senior Energy Analyst with deep knowledge of the German power market to join our Berlin office. You'll be the second person in the office and a senior voice for Gridcog in Germany.

Your main job is to own our German customer relationships. You'll make sure customers model their projects well, get real value from Gridcog and keep choosing us. You'll use your market knowledge and network to make Gridcog a trusted voice in the market, help win new customers and make sure the product works for the target customer group. 

What you'll do

Customers (the core of the role)

  • Own a portfolio of German customer relationships as their main point of contact and trusted advisor
  • Lead onboarding and guide customers on best practice modelling of solar, BESS and hybrid projects in Germany
  • Handle complex technical and market questions, such as ancillary market participation, grid connection constraints, AgNes, and merchant versus contracted revenues
  • Spot where accounts can grow and work with account management on renewals and expansion
  • Keep our German datasets current, including market prices, network tariffs and project assumptions

Sales and marketing

  • Lead demos and technical conversations with prospects, including senior stakeholders, e.g., partners, investment managers, MDs
  • Build Gridcog's credibility in Germany and Central Europe through speaking at events and through your professional network, e.g., on LinkedIn
  • Translate regulatory changes and market design developments into clear insight for customers
  • Create blogs, videos and market commentary on the German market
  • Speak and present at industry events

Product

  • Bring German market requirements into product development and make sure they are understood and prioritised
  • Feed market changes into product direction and feature development
  • Test new features against real client use cases

What it's like being second in the office

Much of how we operate in Germany is still being built, and you'll often be the one setting it up. There won't always be a playbook. You'll need to make calls with incomplete information, act on them and adjust as you learn. We value moving fast over getting everything perfect, and we'd rather you ship something good and improve it than hold it back.

To be successful in this role you will have

  • 3 to 10 years' experience in the German power sector, with solid knowledge of market dynamics, regulation and commercial models for utility-scale solar and battery storage
  • A track record of owning client relationships and delivering excellent outcomes for them
  • The confidence and credibility to represent Gridcog externally, lead demos and engage senior stakeholders
  • Comfort working in an unstructured environment, making decisions and learning from what doesn't work
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data
  • An engaging communication style and the motivation to create content and present at events over time
  • A collaborative mindset and enthusiasm for working in a growing, international team
  • Fluent German and English, and based in or open to relocating to Berlin

We'd also love it if you have

  • Experience in sales or pre-sales, such as demos or client-facing analysis
  • Practical experience in energy project modelling
  • Familiarity with tools such as Excel, Tableau, Python or R
  • Exposure to other European energy markets

Benefits

  • Competitive remuneration package aligned with experience and skills
  • A Berlin office with flexible working arrangements
  • A high-performing team that values innovation and creative problem-solving
  • Exposure and influence over markets beyond Germany / Central Europe through our international footprint and global teams
  • Support for ongoing professional and personal development
  • An annual all-company retreat, with recent locations including Bali and Bintan Island

Diversity and inclusion

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team at Gridcog. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, as we believe an inclusive environment and diversity of perspective lead to innovation and success.

jobs.description:

As a Quantitative Researcher & Methodology Specialist (f/m/d), you will develop innovative quantitative models for the private capital industry. You will identify new analytical approaches, validate their value, and actively shape the methodological evolution of our products. Your tasks:

Quantitative Research & Model Development

  • Develop and enhance quantitative models for the valuation, forecasting, risk assessment, and benchmarking of private capital funds and investments
  • Analyze complex financial, market, and portfolio data to create new analytical methodologies
  • Research and evaluate innovative mathematical and statistical approaches
  • Continuously improve existing model logic, assumptions, and calculation methodologies
  • Translate research outcomes into prototypes, production-ready code, or implementation specifications
Model Validation & Quality Assurance
  • Perform regular validation of quantitative models and methodologies
  • Ensure the quality, transparency, and explainability of quantitative results
  • Support the ongoing quality assurance of production model outputs
  • Create audit-ready model and validation documentation
  • Develop and maintain quantitative modeling standards and best practices
Product Innovation & Methodology Strategy
  • Contribute to the development of the analytics product roadmap
  • Identify new analytical products, methodologies, and service opportunities
  • Evaluate academic, scientific, and technological developments for their relevance to our products
  • Drive innovative approaches for future analytics solutions
  • Support the prioritization of new methodological developments
Stakeholder Management & Client Support
  • Act as a subject matter expert for Product Management, Information Systems, Operations, and other business teams
  • Support the onboarding of new clients in relation to quantitative models and analytics products
  • Communicate complex methodologies and results to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Translate business challenges into quantitative research and modeling approaches
Scientific Collaboration
  • Monitor relevant developments in research and academia
  • Engage with universities, research institutions, and the broader scientific community
  • Support scientific collaborations and academic thesis projects
  • Translate research findings into internal and external communication materials


Your profile

How You Work

  • You enjoy solving complex challenges through quantitative methods
  • You combine scientific rigor with practical applicability
  • You challenge existing approaches and continuously seek improvements
  • You think analytically, structurally, and with a long-term perspective
  • You communicate complex topics in a clear and understandable manner
  • You enjoy interdisciplinary collaboration and independent ownership
  • You are motivated by shaping the future of data-driven analytics solutions
Your Qualifications
  • Degree, ideally including a Master's degree, PhD, or comparable research experience, in Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Finance, Econometrics, Data Science, or a comparable quantitative discipline
  • Strong experience in mathematical and statistical model development
  • Experience implementing quantitative models in code
  • Experience in model validation and methodology development
  • Experience in prototyping, research, or innovation projects
  • Exposure to financial markets, investments, or financial analytics
  • Knowledge of private capital is an advantage
  • Experience with Python and databases is an advantage
Languages

  • Exciting challenges and excellent development opportunities in a constantly growing, international team
  • Freedom to develop own ideas and thus make an active contribution to the success of our company
  • Attractive remuneration with variable components as part of a total compensation system
  • Great colleagues, a friendly working atmosphere and numerous employee events
  • Modern workplace in the heart of Munich with view of the Theresienwiese
  • Modern employee benefits - bike leasing, meal vouchers, BAV, Deutschlandticket, benefits account & Wellpass Fitness
  • Hybrid working model 
  • Free drinks and fruit as well as a well-filled ice box in summer

jobs.title: Head of Brand (Relocation to Milan)
jobs.description:
Please note that this opportunity requires relocation to our Milan office.

About us

Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close.

Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world.

Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.

What you'll be doing

As our Head of Brand, you'll own the creative and brand strategy end-to-end, bridging the gap between high-level storytelling and measurable business impact, ensuring our mission resonates across every touchpoint.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Creative Production - Owning the production of creative assets, ensuring every output meets a consistently high bar of quality, craft, and brand consistency.

  • Brand Activation - Driving both ATL (TV, radio, OOH, print) and BTL/untraditional activations, bringing the brand to life in bold and memorable ways.

  • Social Media & Community - Steering our presence across existing Social media channels and new ones, while building an influencer strategy that extends our reach and relevance.

  • Brand Strategy & Insights - Shaping and safeguarding brand identity, and grounding decisions in research and listening, including surveys with both customers and non-customers.

  • Leadership & Team Rituals - Building and mentoring the team behind these pillars, establishing clear creative rituals (design reviews, sprints, feedback loops) and tools to ensure efficient, high-quality output.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration - Partnering closely with Growth and Product teams to align brand initiatives with acquisition goals, retention targets, and product launches.

  • Performance-Driven Branding - Defining and tracking KPIs for brand awareness and consideration, ensuring that even the most "creative" projects are data-informed and contribute to Satispay's overarching OKRs.

You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.

Who we're looking for

You'll take on one of the hardest challenges at our scale: defining Satispay's identity globally while ensuring our brand initiatives directly align with acquisition and retention goals — and building the creative team and rituals that stay ahead of it as we grow. We're not looking for a caretaker of an existing setup. We're looking for someone who has built or transformed a function, made hard calls under pressure, and can say "here's the decision, here's why, here's what happened."

  • 10+ years of experience - Proven track record in brand management or creative direction, ideally within fast-growing tech companies or top-tier creative agencies.

  • Strong Technical & Visual Culture - Deep understanding of design systems, rebranding processes, and multi-channel campaign production (from social media to TV/OOH).

  • A "Hands-on" Leader - You love to lead by example. You're not just a "manager of resources" but someone who can get into the details of a layout or a script to ensure excellence.

  • Data-Informed Mindset - Ability to translate brand concepts into business objectives, utilizing KPIs and OKRs to measure impact and iterate quickly.

  • Exceptional Communicator - Fluent in English, with the ability to simplify complex brand visions for internal stakeholders and external audiences alike.

We recognise that exceptional leadership comes in many forms. If you believe you have the vision, experience, and drive to help us shape the future of money, we encourage you to apply. We value the unique perspectives and strengths that exceptional leaders bring, even if their experience doesn't align with every listed requirement.

Why this is your place

This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impact are met with meaningful rewards and opportunities.

  • Own outcomes that reach millions. Lead functions where the results show up directly in the experience of 6.5M+ people and the businesses they pay every day.

  • Operate in high-growth. You'll make high-stakes calls without waiting for perfect information, in an environment that changes fast as we launch and scale new products.

  • Significant equity participation. Directly share in Satispay's success through a competitive Stock Option Plan designed to reward leadership and contribution to company growth and raise the bar for collective success.

  • Lead exceptional teams. Build, mentor, and collaborate with high-performing teams in a culture of ownership, collective success, and continuous improvement fueled by feedback. You will learn from the best and lead alongside founders who are hands-on.

CareAbout: how we support your impact

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:

  • ❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.

  • 💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.

  • ⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.

  • 🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.

  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.

*We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.

Initial salary: Starting from €65,000 gross per annum

This baseline is set using objective, gender-neutral criteria for the role's core requirements. However, we do not believe in putting a ceiling on talent. The final compensation package is tailored according to your unique experience and expertise. If your skills go beyond the standard profile, apply anyway so we can discuss a package that reflects your true value.

Equal opportunity employer
At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin.
Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!

Learn more about us
Curious what it's actually like here? Our values and pillars shape how we work every day: explore them here.

About the job

Mistral is hiring a Head of FDE Learning Programs to build the learning system for one of the company’s fastest-growing organizations. Mistral is scaling its FDE organization from its first hire to several hundred Deployment Strategists and Applied AI Engineers within two years.   • We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care.

  • No politics. Low ego, high standards.

  • We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it.

About you

You have helped build a learning, enablement, or capability function for a technical organization during rapid growth. You can start as the first dedicated owner, deliver useful programs immediately, and build the team and operating model needed to serve several hundred people.

  • You are technically fluent enough to work credibly with AI engineers, Product, and Science, inspect the substance of a program, and challenge material that is unclear or outdated.

  • You have designed programs that work across cohorts, regions, and experience levels without reducing the content to generic training.

  • You can lead work across senior stakeholders, subject-matter experts, managers, and operational partners without relying on reporting lines.

  • You can make firm trade-offs when hiring demand, expert capacity, and program quality compete for attention.

  • You pay attention to the full learner experience, including communications, scheduling, practice, feedback, and manager follow-through.

  • You use evidence to decide which programs to expand, revise, or stop.

  • You communicate clearly with executives, managers, technical experts, and learners.

  • You are fluent in English and can work with teams across regions and time zones.

  • Scaled a one-person or small learning function into a team and program that served hundreds of technical employees.

  • Built onboarding that kept pace with rapid hiring in an engineering, FDE, solutions, consulting, or professional-services organization.

  • Designed and operated technical bootcamps or other cohort-based learning programs.

Mistral is compressing years of organization growth into two. Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

 L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

 

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École.

Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche  articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.

Vous rêvez d’une industrie propre, efficace et durable ? Le centre SPIN en fait sa priorité.

Énergie, environnement, procédés industriels… on y conçoit des systèmes pour produire mieux, avec moins.

L’objectif ? Limiter l’impact environnemental, réduire la consommation énergétique et booster l’efficacité.

🔧 Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nos équipes déploient leur créativité scientifique pour accompagner l’industrie du futur. 

Et vous, prêt·e à innover à nos côtés ?

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que chercheur postdoctoal, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche et innovation affecté au centre SPIN. Au sein de ce centre vous conjuguez curiosité scientifique avec un intérêt pour l’articulation entre problématiques de recherche fondamentale et problématiques indus-trielles.

Le centre SPIN est l’un des centres de recherche de Mines Saint-Etienne dédié à la recherche en génie des procédés et rassemble environ 80 personnes comprenant enseignants-chercheurs, postdocs, doctorants, stagiaires, et profite du soutien de personnels administratifs et techniques. L’activité du centre SPIN s’inscrit dans le périmètre du Laboratoire Georges Friedel (UMR 5307) et du Laboratoire Environnement Ville et Société (UMR 5600). Vous développerez votre activité de recherche au sein du département « Procédés de Manipulation de la Matière Granulaire » (PMMG) qui concentre divers expertises scientifiques sur les procédés de transformation et la caractérisa-tion de matériaux granulaires à partir d’approches expérimentales et numériques, ainsi qu’à travers différents champs disciplinaires allant de la géométrie mathématique à la chimie minérale en pas-sant par la physique des écoulements complexes. L’activité du centre SPIN, comme du départe-ment PMMG, est caractérisée par une forte interdisciplinarité ainsi que par de nombreuses collabo-rations avec d’autres institutions de recherche et d’enseignement en Europe et dans le monde, et profite de nombreux contrats avec des partenaires industriels.

La matière granulaire est un état de la matière particulier qui peine à être décrit par les lois de com-portement qui s’appliquent habituellement aux fluides, ou aux solides. Cependant une vaste majo-rité des matières premières transformées dans de nombreux secteurs industriels, ou des produits manufacturés, se présentent sous la forme de particules solides (grains de poudre, agglomérats, granulés, comprimés, etc..). La complexité de la dynamique de ces solides divisés émerge du grand nombre de particules solides concernées. En particulier dans le cas de particules solides transpor-tées dans une conduite de transport pneumatique, où l’écoulement d’un gaz le long d’une con-duite entraine les particules solides, les interactions avec les parois solides sont le siège de nom-breux procédés physico-chimiques. Au-delà des collisions élastiques qui entraînent le rebond de la majorité des particules solides sur les parois, des processus de fragmentation, d’arrachement de charges, d’échauffement local, etc. sont susceptibles de provoquer des transformations de la ma-tière transportée. Dans certains cas, la formation de dépôts sur les parois peut être observée et affecte négativement les performances du procédé de transport.

Le travail attendu sera de mettre en place un montage expérimental capable d’étudier les proces-sus responsables de la formation de ces enrochements à partir de mesures de pression, de débit, de charges électrostatiques, d’observation par microscopie, de caractérisation granulométrique etc. Différentes poudres modèles pourront être utilisées afin de reproduire les observations d’enrochement reportées dans la litérature. L’équipe d’encadrement sera constituée d’enseignants-chercheurs du centre SPIN ainsi que d’ingénieurs R&D de notre partenaire industriel ORANO.

ou d’un diplôme d’ingénieur

Une expérience significative en publication et communication de résultats scientifique est at-tendue ainsi qu’une maitrise de la langue anglaise écrite et orale.

· Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The AI Customer Success function is being built from the ground up, and this role will help define it internationally. As the first Customer Success Manager in this area, you will own the end-to-end post-sale experience for a portfolio of customers that includes some of the world’s most sophisticated cyber threat intelligence teams and investigators, national security agencies, and financial crime teams. Your mandate is not just to manage accounts—you will help establish the playbook, define what success looks like, and drive a product-led growth motion that turns new customers into long-term, expanding partners.

The impact you will have:

  • Build and ship a v1 onboarding playbook within the first 30 days—a practical, working version built from early customer engagements that can be iterated as you learn what drives adoption across international customer segments.

  • Use AI to build production CS workflows that pull from ChurnZero, Salesforce, Gong, and product usage telemetry to auto-generate account health summaries and QBR drafts—compressing hours of reporting preparation into minutes so you can spend your time on the work that actually requires human judgment.

  • Define and track adoption benchmarks across the portfolio—hands-on-keyboard usage, consumption rates, and account-specific success metrics—and surface at-risk accounts before renewal decisions are made.

  • Identify and scope the highest-impact PLG play within 60 days by working backwards from expansion targets, focusing on the one or two use cases most likely to drive consumption across the customer base.

  • Run executive business reviews and QBRs with senior stakeholders at government agencies and financial institutions internationally—building the trust and credibility that turns TRM from a vendor into a mission-critical partner.

  • Partner with ADs on expansion plays, co-own NRR targets, and build the structured path to proving value for every customer with an expiring or at-risk contract.

  • Close the feedback loop between customers and Product—synthesize adoption blockers, feature gaps, and new use-case opportunities into prioritized, actionable input that informs the roadmap.

  • Design the CS infrastructure and tooling stack that scales as the product grows—you are building the foundation the next CSM hire will inherit.

What we're looking for:

  • Background in cyber or cyber threat intelligence, intelligence agencies, financial crime investigations, or regulatory and compliance environments.

  • 5+ years as an onboarding engineer, customer success manager, deployment strategist, or in another post-sale role with proven ownership of NRR, GRR, and expansion metrics—you have the track record, not just the title.

  • Domain credibility in cyber, national security, or financial crime—you can walk into a room of investigators and earn their trust in the first meeting, not the fifth.

  • Demonstrated zero-to-one builder experience—you have built a CS function, onboarding playbook, or PLG motion from scratch and can point to the specific outcomes it drove.

  • Production AI fluency—you have built real, repeatable AI workflows, not just experiments, that synthesize data from multiple sources into outputs that run consistently and deliver measurable results. You can show the workflow, explain the data logic, and articulate where human judgment stays in the loop.

  • A high level of independence—you set your own agenda, operate without needing constant direction, and ship v1 before you have all the answers.

  • Strong executive presence—you can run a QBR with a senior government stakeholder or financial institution executive and command the room through substance, not just polish.

  • Experience supporting international customers, with the ability to navigate regional, cultural, and time-zone differences.

About the Team:

  • This team focuses on TRM’s AI-driven Intel platform, supporting investigators and cyber teams working on complex cases involving cyber threats.

  • This is the first Customer Success hire dedicated to international customers—you will help build the function from the ground up, with high autonomy, direct access to leadership, and meaningful influence on how TRM approaches customer success globally.

  • The broader TRM CS organization operates distributed, not distant—async-first communication through Slack, strong documentation, and intentional synchronous time for key decisions.

  • You will work directly with the Head of Customer Success and Patrick South, CRO, with close day-to-day collaboration with international Sales teams and Product.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • As a globally distributed team, members work across multiple time zones. This role will primarily align its working hours and customer coverage with international markets, with flexibility to collaborate across regions when needed.

  • Our Customer Success team is fully remote, thriving on asynchronous communication and collaboration through Slack channels and detailed documentation. We hold weekly customer syncs, biweekly health syncs, join our associated POD calls, and regularly engage with customers across international markets. As experts in our craft, we focus on providing support, driving value, and building meaningful relationships with our customers as trusted advisors. We are on the front lines of TRM, ensuring our customers get the most out of the product and bringing valuable insights back to the team.

  • The team moves fast and iterates—v1 ships before it is perfect, and feedback is expected to be direct and specific.

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • End-to-End Ownership: While there is no formal hourly rotation, you will be the primary lead for your area and responsible for customer success across international markets. This requires a high degree of agency and a commitment to seeing mission-critical tasks through to resolution, including the flexibility to handle urgent needs outside of standard hours or on weekends when they arise.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within 30 days of joining, you ship a working v1 onboarding playbook built from your first 2–3 accounts—not a slide deck, but a live document with measurable adoption benchmarks that the account team is already using to set customer expectations.

  • Within 6 weeks, you share a draft success-metrics framework at 50% complete with the account team and key customers to validate direction—getting real signal on what drives credit consumption before investing further in building out the full playbook.

  • Within 60 days, you identify and scope the highest-impact PLG play by working backwards from expansion targets—presenting a concrete recommendation to leadership on which use case to prioritize and why, grounded in actual account data from international customers.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure you’re considered.

What to Expect From Our Interview Process

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while giving you the opportunity to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, AI skills assessment, and Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Explore your experience, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Dive deeper into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: Typically 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Typically 3–5 interviews to go deeper on your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: We’ll speak with former colleagues who can provide perspective on your work and impact.

  • Offer: If it’s a mutual fit, your recruiter will walk you through your offer and answer your questions.

  • Welcome to TRM: Once you sign, we’ll get you ready for your first day and onboarding.

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

Learn more about interviewing at TRM

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate

  • Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more about Interviewing at TRM

 

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. Learn more about building tools for defenders.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

The Field Application Engineer (FAE) is a hands-on, vehicle system-level role. You will work directly on prototype vehicles and lab cars to investigate complex, cross-subsystem issues, capturing the data needed to reproduce and isolate them. You will also provide diagnostic and integration support on-site at partner facilities. The focus is on getting close to the hardware and the buses, producing clear findings that development teams can act on.

This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite, with occasional travel to other company and partner sites as needed.

 

Responsibilities

  • Perform hands-on diagnostics on prototype vehicles, including capturing network traces (CAN, LIN, Ethernet) and real-time data logs from ECUs and zonal controllers.

  • Work at the vehicle system level to reproduce, characterize, and isolate reported issues across interacting subsystems.

  • Set up and operate measurement and diagnostic equipment to gather ground-truth data directly from the vehicle.

  • Run first-pass triage of field-reported symptoms to help distinguish software defects from environmental or hardware issues.

  • Reproduce and characterize reported issues on target vehicles and test benches..

  • Document technical findings, logs, and reproduction steps into clear hand-off reports for development teams.

  • Log and update technical tickets in Jira, keeping status and evidence current..

  • Travel to customer / partner sites, both domestically and internationally, for on-site diagnostics and integration support.

  • Foundational understanding of automotive network protocols (CAN, LIN, Ethernet) and willingness to deepen it quickly.

  • Hands-on experience with bus-monitoring / diagnostic tools (e.g., Vector CANalyzer, PCAN, or equivalent) — required.

  • Basic understanding of embedded systems and embedded operating systems.

  • Scripting/programming ability (Python and/or C/C++) for log processing and data capture.

jobs.title: Tech Lead (f/d/m)
jobs.description:
A definitive shift is currently happening. Corporates across the globe are no longer just reporting on sustainability; they are actively investing in it as a core financial and strategic asset.

At CEEZER, we are architecting the infrastructure for enterprise-grade Climate Performance Asset management, transforming how the world's largest companies source and manage carbon credits, Energy Attribution Certificates (EAC), and Sustainable Aviation Fuel certificates (SAFc).

Our platform gives the world’s most ambitious enterprises the data-driven precision, real-time monitoring, and framework-compliant reporting required to confidently deploy capital toward high-impact Climate Performance Asset portfolios and true, measurable climate action.

Tasks

Your mission

We are looking for a Tech Lead to join our engineering team. This role requires an ambitious technical leader who can architect scalable systems, navigate complex carbon data architectures, and drive engineering excellence. Moving beyond traditional software delivery, you will translate product vision into reliable technology, lead critical architectural decisions, and leave a lasting mark on our platform from day one.

  • Architect and scale a seamless B2B procurement platform, delivering an intuitive, enterprise-grade user interface designed for daily engagement and complex workflows.
  • Drive end-to-end technical strategy, design, and architecture, translating ambitious product requirements into performant, scalable features and microservices.
  • Lead by example with hands-on technical execution, authoring high-quality, maintainable code across our TypeScript, Node.js, and Next.js stack.
  • Cultivate engineering excellence across the team, providing high-impact mentorship, technical guidance, and rigorous code reviews to continuously elevate development standards.
  • Safeguard platform integrity, establishing robust security, reliability, and performance standards across our applications and core cloud infrastructure.
  • Partner closely with product, design, and cross-functional teams, evaluating trade-offs and technical permutations to engineer optimal, user-centric solutions.

Requirements

What you need to succeed

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of technical leadership (2+ years) guiding teams through complex, full-lifecycle product deliveries.
  • Deep technical proficiency in TypeScript and the Node.js ecosystem, alongside extensive hands-on experience building modern, data-dense interfaces with React or Next.js.
  • Strong architectural expertise in RESTful API design, backend systems architecture, and relational data modelling (PostgreSQL experience preferred).
  • Demonstrated commitment to engineering rigour, with a deep understanding of software design patterns, enterprise web security standards, and modern development workflows (Git, feature branching).
  • Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure and continuous deployment, including hands-on experience building and maintaining services on platforms like AWS.
  • Exceptional collaborative and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical decisions, bridge alignment across product teams, and mentor engineers.
  • Basic familiarity with Python is a plus, or a strong technical curiosity to expand into auxiliary parts of our data processing stack.

Benefits

What's in it for you at CEEZER?

  • A mission that matters: Work alongside international teams combining finance, tech, and climate science professionals to direct capital toward the world's most critical climate assets.
  • Accelerated growth: We are scaling fast, and your career will too. Take opportunities to lead cross-functional initiatives and expand your strategic influence.
  • True ownership: We are building in a brand-new market, meaning many of our best practices don’t exist yet. If you see a better workflow, tool, or strategy, you have the autonomy and backing to build it.
  • An empowering environment: We bring together diverse global perspectives, knowing that solving complex climate challenges requires a wide mix of backgrounds and expertise.
  • Real enterprise impact: Transform how global corporates approach sustainability. CEEZER hosts 50Mt+ of vetted carbon credits across all pathways, all backed by sophisticated data and institutional-grade risk management.
  • A net-zero career: We practice what we preach. From your first day, we fully offset your personal and professional carbon footprint because sustainability is how we operate.

The hiring process

  • An intro call with the People Team
  • A Technical Interview with our SVP of Tech, Felipe
  • A Case Study with 2 Engineers from the team

Create an impact with us?

We know that great talent doesn’t always follow a linear path. If your experience doesn't check every single box on this list, but you have the drive and unique strengths to excel here, we still want to hear from you.

Here, building a diverse team isn't a checkbox—It’s how we solve complex global challenges. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, skills, and potential, while actively working to keep unconscious bias out of our process. We’ve created an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered to succeed. We welcome diverse applicants and are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for everyone to thrive.

If you need any adjustments or specific accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. We are here to support you.

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Your Mission

Cosuno is a B2B marketplace connecting general contractors and subcontractors across the construction industry. As our Senior Lifecycle & Retention Manager, you'll build the growth engine that turns new users into active, paying and retained customers — and move us toward an AI-native, signal-driven system that decides what happens next on its own. You'll be one of the first to join the marketing lead in a lean marketing team: you'll shape how it operates as it scales, not just execute inside a fixed setup.

What you’ll do

  • You build the CRM programmes and lifecycle journeys that drive adoption and conversion — from first tender discovery to paid conversion for subcontractors, and early product adoption to repeat tendering for construction companies.

  • Together with the Marketing Lead, you build an agentic, signal-driven system that turns behavioural data, call insights and enrichment signals into personalised next-best-action triggers — replacing static journeys with ones that decide what happens next on their own.

  • You experiment and measure with A/B tests and holdout groups, so decisions are based on incremental impact, not campaign output.

  • You scale what works into a repeatable system, not one-off campaigns.

  • You connect journeys with Sales and Customer Success, handing off to a human touch when that's more effective than automation.

  • You use CRM as a lever for marketplace liquidity — getting the right subcontractors onto the right tenders — and orchestrate email, in-app, transactional comms and marketplace recommendations as one journey with Product.

  • You support growth programmes such as referrals — from design through CRM execution.

What You Bring

  • You've owned CRM, lifecycle, retention or growth programmes and can show the commercial impact they created — ideally in B2B SaaS or a two-sided business model.

  • You've directly influenced conversion, activation or retention metrics and are confident with data and experimentation.

  • You're genuinely AI-native: proven experience building AI-driven automation or agentic CRM systems, not just using AI to write copy faster.

  • You write and run SQL queries independently.

  • You go from data → insight → idea → implementation → result without needing someone else to define every step, and you like solving ambiguous problems and building from scratch.

  • You work effectively across Product, Sales, Customer Success and Engineering, and care more about measurable business impact than campaign output.

  • A plus: hands-on experience with ActiveCampaign and Salesforce (or comparable CRM tools).

  • Fluent in written and spoken German and English.

Your Benefits

  • Room to shape and grow: One of the first marketing hires — real ownership of lifecycle and CRM, with plenty of space to make an impact.

  • AI at the core: Our product uses AI to analyze millions of price data points and help construction companies bid better — and we invest in it just as much internally. You'll build with the latest tools and move fast, not wait for approval.

  • Competitive compensation: Salary above market average, permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

  • Work-life balance: Fully remote or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg, flexible hours.

  • Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro.

  • A great team: Open, international, with regular off-sites and team events.

  • Growth & feedback: Open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations.

About us

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Join us – Build the future of construction.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Engineer
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based at our HQ in Munich or Cologne.

About the role

You solve the hard technical problems on live systems.

Once a customer is running on blp, their processes are business critical. Invoices post or they do not. Orders flow or they sit. Our support organisation resolves most of what comes in, and a lot of it is genuinely well handled by people early in their career. What is left is yours: the cases where the cause is not obvious, where it crosses systems, data and process logic at once, where the same symptom has three possible explanations and only one of them is right.

That is the job. Not a queue, and not the easy half of one. Everything difficult that comes out of the run phase lands with you.

Two things sit alongside the case work, and they are what make this a senior job rather than a harder version of a junior one.

Stabilising accounts
When an account's health goes bad, you go in and stabilise it. Not as a permanent assignment, but as a small, highly skilled squad that takes a customer whose numbers or whose confidence have slipped, works out what is actually wrong across the whole picture, fixes it, and hands back a customer who is running properly again. It is the most concentrated version of this work there is.

Taking effort out permanently
Anything that keeps arriving in the queue is a signal, and the answer is usually not more people answering it. It might be better self-service for customers, a customer-facing assistant that resolves the routine questions before they reach us, better diagnostics, or a change in how something is configured at deployment so the problem never occurs. You are expected to find those, make the case, and drive them through. That is how a support organisation scales without scaling headcount one for one, and it is value the customer feels directly.

You work across the boundary between what our platform does, what the customer's ERP does, and what their data actually looks like. You are the one who can read a failing case end to end and say what really happened, and then say credibly whether the fix is configuration, data, process, or a genuine product issue. When it is a product issue, you are the counterpart to our engineering and product teams: you bring the evidence, and because you have seen the same structural problem across several customers, your case is the one that moves the roadmap.

You are also how this function gets better rather than just bigger. The diagnostic tooling, the patterns, the documentation that lets a first-year person resolve what used to take a senior one: that is yours to build. And the interns and specialists coming through the team learn this craft from you.

You do not deliver integrations and you do not run go-lives. Our integrations engineers and technical project managers own that. You own what happens once it is live and it is challenging.

What you'll do

  • Own the technically difficult cases from our live customer base, end to end, to a verified root cause.

  • Diagnose across boundaries: platform behaviour, ERP behaviour, master data and process logic.

  • Decide what the real fix is, and make it: configuration, data, process, or a case for engineering.

  • Go into accounts with a deteriorating health score, diagnose across the whole picture, stabilise them and hand them back running properly.

  • Drive strategic initiatives that permanently reduce effort and improve the customer experience, from better diagnostics to customer-facing self-service and assistants.

  • Act as the counterpart to Product and Engineering, with evidence strong enough to change priorities.

  • Recognise structural problems across customers and push for them to be solved once.

  • Build the diagnostic tooling, patterns and documentation that raise what the rest of the team can resolve alone.

  • Mentor interns and earlier-career colleagues, and raise the technical bar of the function.

  • Support Consultants and Customer Success Managers on the technical substance of customer escalations.

What we're really looking for

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Root Cause, Not Symptom – You are not finished when it stops happening. You are finished when you know why.

  • Cross-Boundary Reasoning – You hold platform, ERP, data and process in your head at once and find where the truth is.

  • Credible Both Ways – You explain the same problem to an engineer and to a CFO, and both of them believe you.

  • Leverage – Your instinct is to remove the next hundred cases, not only to close this one. You would rather build the thing that makes a problem stop arriving.

  • Calm Under Escalation – When a business-critical process is stopped, you get more precise rather than faster.

  • Stabilizer Under Pressure: An unhappy client is not a fire to put out. It is a relationship to rebuild. You bring the temperature down, put structure back into the account, and align next steps so trust returns, not just silence

What you'll bring

  • Master's degree in a STEM field: computer science, engineering, information systems, mathematics, physics or similar. Strong candidates from a related field are welcome to make their case.

  • 3+ years in a technical customer-facing role: application support at depth, technical consulting, solution engineering, integration engineering or equivalent.

  • Demonstrable debugging ability across systems, not only within one. APIs, data mapping, interfaces, logs.

  • Comfortable with data. SQL or equivalent, and the instinct to check rather than assume.

  • German and English, both fluent. This is a hard requirement. Our customers work in German every day and our internal work runs in English.

  • Nice to have: ERP experience with SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or similar, scripting in any language, or exposure to workflow automation and process mining.

What you'll get

  • The hard problems, not the queue.

  • Influence on the product, with a direct line to Engineering and Product.

  • Room to shape the function, since the practice is still being built.

  • Real growth – the path from here leads into Consulting, technical leadership within Customer Success, or Product.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option programme.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Visits & offsites – including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

Qui sommes-nous ?

Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d’utilisateurs dans 98 pays, nos solutions s’imposent aujourd’hui comme des références sur le   marché :

N2F : gestion des dépenses professionnelles (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs)

Keeple : gestion RH du quotidien (congés, absences, temps de travail)

L’entreprise est en forte croissance avec une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Pourquoi ce poste ?

Notre écosystème d’outils s’est construit progressivement avec la croissance de l’entreprise. Il est aujourd’hui riche mais encore insuffisamment structuré :

jobs.title: Senior C# Software Engineer – Manchester
jobs.description:
Our Story
 
Hello there. We’re Zopa.
 
We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com! 
 
We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. 
 
If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife

The Engineering Challenge
 
Our Software Engineers don't just write code, they solve real financial problems for millions of customers. You'll work on distributed systems processing thousands of transactions daily, build resilient services that handle people's money, and create experiences that make traditionally complex financial products feel simple.

We care deeply about great engineering, which is why our core stack is Kotlin, running on a modern platform with Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker and AWS Aurora Postgres. But great engineers aren’t defined by a single language which is why we are agnostic with our hiring.

We want the right people, not the 'right' language, so if you come from a C#/.NET background, bring solid fundamentals, and have an appetite for learning something new, we’ll invest in you, help you grow your skills and confidently step into our Kotlin ecosystem.

Your Impact
  • Writing clean, reliable and maintainable backend code using Kotlin 
  • Working on scalable cloud-based systems within a product-focused Agile team 
  • Collaborating with engineers, product managers and designers to build and ship features 
  • Taking part in planning, technical discussions and code reviews 
  • Building well-tested services and contributing to continuous delivery 
  • Taking ownership of your work — from development to production 
  • Continuously learning and developing your skills in a supportive environment 

    • Your Toolkit
  • You’ve got some solid hands-on experience with C# but open to learning Java or Kotlin
  • You care about writing good quality code and value clean design and testing 
  • You’re curious, eager to learn and not afraid to ask questions 
  • You enjoy solving problems and working as part of a collaborative team 
  • You want to build things that have a real impact on customers 
  • You communicate clearly and are happy contributing to team decisions 
  • You’re excited by modern engineering practices like CI/CD and cloud-native tools 

    • Our Engineering Culture
  • Customer impact over unnecessary complexity
  • Team success over individual heroics
  • Operational ownership, not just feature delivery
  • Continuous improvement through honest feedback

    • Added Bonus
  • Experience with fintech or banking is a plus, but we value problem-solvers from all backgrounds
    • #ON-LI1

    At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.
    We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our Manchester office 2-3 days a week. (WeWork, Dalton Place, 29 John Dalton Street, M2 6WF) Please note this office is dog friendly so you might see some furry friends about!
     
    You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.
     
    *Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice
     
    Diversity Statement 
    Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments. 
     

    Our approach to AI in interviews

    At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs. 

    Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process. 

    Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other. 

    Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

DEINE ROLLE

Zahlen sind für dich kein Selbstzweck, sondern die Grundlage guter Entscheidungen? Du willst kein kleines Rädchen in einer großen Finanzabteilung sein, sondern echte Verantwortung und tiefe Einblicke in die Abläufe eines FinTechs? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Als (Junior) Finance Manager (m/w/d) arbeitest du in einem schlagkräftigen, kleinen Finance Team direkt mit dem VP Finance zusammen – und übernimmst von Tag eins an Verantwortung. Von der laufenden Buchhaltung über Monats- und Jahresabschluss bis zu Reporting, Forecasts und der Automatisierung unserer Prozesse deckst du die gesamte Bandbreite ab – und siehst unmittelbar, wie deine Arbeit bei Management, Investoren und Board ankommt. So entwickelst du ein tiefes Verständnis der finanziellen Steuerung eines der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter Europas – und prägst sie aktiv mit.

Was machst du dabei konkret?

  • Monatsabschluss: Du übernimmst eigenständig wiederkehrende Reporting- und Abschlussaufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass unser Monatsabschluss steht – pünktlich und verlässlich

  • Jahresabschluss: Du bringst dich in die Vorbereitung des HGB Jahresabschlusses ein und unterstützt unsere Accountants und Wirtschaftsprüfer beim Audit.

  • Reporting: Du erstellst KPIs und Finanzkennzahlen für Management-Präsentationen und wirkst an Investoren- und Board-Unterlagen mit.

  • Analysen: Du baust Finanzmodelle, Forecasts und Abweichungsanalysen und machst aus Zahlen belastbare Insights.

  • Prozessautomatisierung: Du digitalisierst und automatisierst unsere Finanzprozesse u.a. über AI Anwendungen – und findest die Tools, die uns morgen schneller machen.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Erfahrung & Qualifikation: Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung und/oder ein Studium. Erste praktische Erfahrung im Accounting/Controlling, Consulting, Investment Banking oder Venture Capital ist ein Vorteil.

  • Analytische Fähigkeiten: Zahlen sind dein Zuhause: Du denkst analytisch, arbeitest sicher in Excel und findest dich schnell in Tools wie NetSuite, Abacum, Moss oder PowerPoint zurecht. Erfahrung mit Automatisierung und AI Tools ist ein Plus – vieles davon lernst du bei uns on the Job.

  • Mindset: Du bringst eine proaktive, sorgfältige und detailorientierte Arbeitsweise mit und blühst in einem dynamischen, schnell wachsenden Startup Umfeld auf. Du bist ambitioniert, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und ziehst Dinge eigenständig durch.

  • Sprache: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch (mindestens C1) und fühlst dich in einem internationalen Arbeitskontext wohl.

So geht es für dich weiter

Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess die höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte.

  • Erstes virtuelles Kennenlernen mit Larissa: Wir tauschen uns aus, ob Deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Position mit unseren Anforderungen übereinstimmen.

  • Interview mit Jessie: Wir tauchen tiefer in die Rolle und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten ein und lernen uns noch besser kennen. Du hast die Möglichkeit, Fragen zu stellen und mehr über das Internship zu erfahren.

  • Case Study Runde: Gemeinsam mit Jan und einem weiteren Senior Teammitglied wird auf eine typische Situation eingegangen, die Dir in dieser Rolle begegnen könnte. So bekommst Du den bestmöglichen Einblick in den praktischen Alltag.

  • Kennelernen vor Ort: Besuche unser Berliner Büro, lerne die Menschen persönlich kennen, mit denen du eng zusammenarbeiten wirst, und bekomme ein echtes Gefühl für unsere Kultur, unsere Arbeitsweise und unsere gemeinsamen Ziele.

 

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit.

Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem betreuten Vermögen von über 4 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust und Project A zusammen.

 

LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt.

jobs.description:
1-    ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE

Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation.

Le poste est rattaché au Département interdisciplinaire en sciences sociales (DI2S) rassemblant des enseignants chercheurs et enseignantes chercheuses en sciences de gestion, sociologie, économie et droit. Sur le campus de Nantes, les recherches sont focalisées sur l’analyse des transformations des organisations et des métiers dans des systèmes sociotechniques. Trois domaines d’investigation sont privilégiés : l’industrie, la santé et l’environnement. Le ou la candidate sera affilé·e au LEMNA (Laboratoire Économie et Management Nantes Atlantique).

Plus précisément, le poste sera rattaché à la chaire RESOH [Recherche en Sécurité Organisations Hommes]. Les travaux de recherche, à l’interface de la sociologie et de la gestion, portent sur le fonctionnement des organisations à hauts risques. Partant de l’analyse du travail et des organisations de travail, il s’agit d’éclairer les dimensions socio-organisationnelles, managériales et institutionnelles contribuant à (ou empêchant) le maintien d’un niveau de fiabilité compatible avec les exigences de sécurité et de production. Les recherches de la chaire sont conduites en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires industriels et institutionnels. Elles visent à produire des connaissances scientifiques, mais également à favoriser leur mise en discussion, leur appropriation et leur mobilisation par les acteurs concernés.

 

MISSIONS

En collaboration avec l’ensemble des enseignants-chercheurs de l’équipe (permanents et associés), les missions sont :

1-    Participer à l’enquête empirique et à la production scientifique

2-    Contribuer à la réflexion collective

3-    Participer aux réunions de coordination et aux réunions de restitution

4-    Diffuser et valoriser les connaissances et résultats produits

 ACTIVITÉS :

  1. Participer à l’enquête empirique et à la production scientifique

    • Réalise un travail bibliographique sur les thèmes de la chaire ?

    • Participe à l’élaboration du protocole d’enquête (notamment en étant force de proposition pour la sélection des sites et des activités étudiés, les grilles d’entretien et / ou d’observation)

    • Réalise une partie de l’analyse documentaire sur les secteurs industriels à risques (nucléaire, pétrochimie)

    • Participe à la collecte des données au sein des organisations partenaires en mobilisant des méthodologies qualitatives :

      • mène des entretiens semi-directifs avec des personnels (dirigeants, managers, ingénieurs, techniciens, opérateurs) ;

      • pratique des observations directes non participantes de séquence de travail au sein des sites identifiés ;

      • rédige des carnets d’observation ou tout autre document permettant le partage des observations ;

      • prépare et participe éventuellement à des focus groupes.

    • Prend part à la retranscription et au dépouillement des entretiens, aux traitements (manuel et/ou assisté par un logiciel d’analyse) et à l’analyse les données

    • Contribue à l’analyse des restitutions intermédiaires réalisées par l’équipe avec les personnels concerné.

  2. Contribuer à la réflexion collective de l’équipe

    • Contribue activement aux réunions à visée scientifique de l’équipe et aux séminaires de recherche de la chaire (au sein de l’équipe RESOH et avec les partenaires)

  3. Participer aux réunions de coordination de l'équipe et aux restitutions avec les organisations partenaires (au national, et en local en fonction des terrains)

    • Prépare des supports de restitution

    • Participe aux discussions d’équipe

    • Rédige des comptes rendus des restitutions aux enquêtés

  4. Diffuser et valoriser les connaissances et résultats produits

    • Rédige des communications pour des conférences nationales et/ou internationales

    • Contribue à l’organisation et participe aux manifestations scientifiques organisées par l’équipe (exemple : journée d’étude)

    • Participe à l’écriture d’articles à visée scientifique et de vulgarisation


Niveau de formation et/ou expérience minimums requis :

  • Doctorat obtenu moins de 3 ans avant la date d’embauche en sociologie, sciences de gestion ou ergonomie

Compétences, connaissances et expériences indispensables :

  • Bien connaître un ou plusieurs domaines d’expertise parmi les suivants : travail, organisation, outil de gestion, STS, ressources humaines

  • Maîtriser les approches qualitatives, avoir déjà réalisé une ou plusieurs étude(s) de cas (entretien semi-directif, observation non participante, focus group),

  • Avoir une très bonne maîtrise du français pour la réalisation des entretiens lors des enquêtes de terrain avec les membres des organisations partenaires
