jobs.title: System Software Engineer (gn) Cloud & Simulation
jobs.description:
Your mission

At Wandelbots, we are building NOVA, a platform that makes industrial robot programming accessible to everyone. Our Simulation team develops the technologies that allow partners, customers, and internal teams to work with photorealistic digital twins of real production environments.

This includes a pipeline that transforms real-world scans into usable 3D scenes through Gaussian Splatting, as well as a browser-based streaming platform built on NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim. Both technologies work today, but neither is yet operated as a product. Your mission is to change that.

The first step is internal standardization. We want to replace individually maintained environments and hand-crafted deployments with one reproducible, documented solution that teams can use independently: scene in, session out, without requiring the Simulation team to operate every setup.
The second step is external productization. The same capabilities need to be packaged so that partners and customers can operate them in their own environments. 
E.g. with versioned releases, stable interfaces, tenant isolation, diagnostics, upgrade paths, and documentation.

You will join the Simulation team and focus on the infrastructure and operational foundations of these systems. You will not be building them in isolation: Wandelbots has an established infrastructure team responsible for shared infrastructure and platform capabilities. You will work closely with that team while owning the simulation-specific workloads, deployment patterns, and operational requirements.

This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape architecture and make technical decisions in collaboration with the teams involved.

What you will work on

  • Build and operate the GPU infrastructure required by our simulation workloads, including NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, driver lifecycle, and GPU sharing through MIG or time slicing

  • Work with the infrastructure team to integrate simulation workloads into our shared Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure

  • Make deployments declarative and reproducible using Infrastructure as Code and GitOps, and help consolidate the tooling used across today’s environments

  • Own CI/CD and the container and image lifecycle for CUDA- and NGC-based workloads

  • Design scheduling and autoscaling for two distinct workload profiles: latency-sensitive interactive streaming sessions and compute-intensive Gaussian Splatting jobs

  • Turn the Gaussian Splatting pipeline into a reproducible workflow, from data capture and training to OpenUSD assets

  • Operate and extend our Omniverse and Isaac Sim streaming platform, including Kit App Streaming, session lifecycle, and tenant isolation

  • Establish the platform as an internal standard through self-service workflows, golden paths, templates, onboarding, and documentation

  • Prepare the solution for operation by partners and customers through packaged deployments, versioned releases, upgrade paths, and actionable diagnostics

  • Support deployments across cloud, on-premises, and partner-managed environments

  • Build meaningful observability using metrics, logs, GPU telemetry, and actionable alerting

  • Define the simulation-specific security and access model, including ingress, TURN and STUN for WebRTC, RBAC, secrets management, SSO, and tenant boundaries

  • Work closely with our robotics, product, and platform teams to ensure that the solution supports real development and customer workflows



Your profile

We are looking for an engineer who is interested in how complex systems are built, deployed, and operated, not only in delivering the next application feature.
You should bring:

  • Experience building or operating production systems in platform engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or systems software

  • Practical Kubernetes experience, including resource management, workload scheduling, and debugging distributed systems under load

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and CI/CD, together with the ability to evaluate tools based on the problem rather than a fixed preference

  • Solid knowledge of Linux, containers, and networking

  • Good Python skills for automation, services, and data-processing workflows

  • Experience with GPU workloads, or a strong technical foundation and clear interest in working with drivers, CUDA, and GPU scheduling

  • The ability to turn working technology into a system that other teams can use independently

  • A strong sense of operational ownership, including documentation, diagnostics, maintainability, and reproducibility

  • Very good English; German is a plus


We do not expect candidates to have prior experience with every technology in this description. A strong systems foundation, the ability to learn unfamiliar components, and an interest in this problem space are more important than matching every item. The scope and responsibilities of the role will grow with your experience.


Nice to have

  • Experience turning an internally developed system into a product that can be operated in customer-controlled environments

  • Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim, Kit SDK, or OpenUSD

  • Experience with Gaussian Splatting, NeRF, photogrammetry, or comparable 3D reconstruction pipelines

  • Knowledge of WebRTC, pixel streaming, or other low-latency video technologies

  • Python, Rust, or Go skills sufficient to contribute to existing services and infrastructure tooling

  • Experience with robotics or simulation, such as ROS 2 or sim-to-real workflows

  • Experience with multi-tenant platforms, air-gapped deployments, or customer environments with specific security and compliance requirements



Why us?

Make an impact!
Work on an innovative, deep tech product that adds value to the robotics world and to society! Become a crucial part of something new, big and exciting where you can truly make an impact!

Our teams inspire!
Cross-functional communication is key. You'll get to know many of your 100+ colleagues. Collaborate with great people on our international teams who value knowledge sharing and unique ways of doing things!

Be authentic!
Work in a value-driven environment where everything may not be perfect, but we're working on it! Your feedback is required while you receive feedback and appreciation for your work!

Help others!
You can have up to 3 days of volunteer time off to help your favorite charity.

Develop yourself!
We offer training and mental health opportunities so that you can develop both mentally and professionally.

And there is even more!
Enjoy our free lunch, snacks and drinks, team events, 30 days of annual vacation + additional rest during Christmas season until New Year. If your child gets sick, we assure that a 100% of your usual earnings will be paid while you take care of your little one.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer (gn) Industrial Robotics & Software Development
jobs.description:
Your mission

At Wandelbots, we combine modern software development with industrial robotics and automation. With NOVA, we are building a platform that makes the use of industrial robots easier, more flexible, and more software-driven. As an Automation Engineer, you will work right at this intersection: You will commission automation systems and robots, support our teams with your hands-on industrial expertise, and implement customer-specific solutions based on NOVA. You will support projects from technical concept and implementation through to commissioning at the customer site, while bringing insights from real-world automation projects back into our product and engineering teams.

Industrial Robotics & Automation 
You will be responsible for the setup, commissioning, and operation of internal and customer automation systems. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Integrating robots, PLCs, and other peripheral devices into an automation environment 
  • Supporting electrical commissioning, troubleshooting, maintenance, and on-site customer deployments 
  • Acting as a technical point of contact for robotics and industrial automation across our teams 
  • Bringing practical experience from customer projects into technical and product related decisions 

NOVA & Software Development 
You will use Wandelbots NOVA to implement customer-specific robotics and automation solutions and bring an important application perspective into our product development. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Translating customer robotics requirements into NOVA-based software solutions 
  • Developing project-specific applications, workflows, and functionality using Python 
  • Combining and applying existing NOVA capabilities to real industrial use cases 
  • Working closely with Software, Product, and Robotics Engineering on new use cases and technical challenges
  • Providing structured feedback from real-world projects and turning project learnings into reusable solutions and best practices


Your profile

You have hands-on experience in industrial robotics and automation and enjoy working at the intersection of automation and software. Ideally, you bring: 

  • Strong knowledge of industrial robot programming, parameterization, and commissioning 
  • Practical experience with at least one major robot manufacturer such as KUKA, ABB, Yaskawa, FANUC, or Stäubli 
  • Experience with industrial automation systems and customer-site commissioning
  • Basic knowledge of PLC programming and electrical commissioning

  • A basic understanding of software architecture and modern development practices

Your Profile Is Particularly Interesting to Us If …

  • You have experience with industrial communication systems and interfaces 
  • You enjoy working directly with customers, software developers, and automation specialists 
  • You want to do more than just experiment with new technologies and are motivated to bring them into real production environments 

Why This Role? 

This role combines two areas that are increasingly converging in industrial automation: robotics and software development. You will work with real industrial robots and automation systems while also developing NOVA-based solutions for concrete customer applications. This gives you the opportunity to bring the perspective of an industrial user directly into our software and product development. Fachliche Kompetenz, Kommunikationsstärke und die Bereitschaft, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten, sind für uns genauso wichtig wie deine Freude an Zusammenarbeit und daran, gemeinsam gute Lösungen zu entwickeln.

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Why Deliveroo?

We're building the definitive online food company, transforming the way the world eats by making hyper-local food more convenient and accessible. We obsess about building the future of food, whilst using our network as a force for good. We're at the forefront of a industry, powered by our market-leading technology and unrivalled network to bring incredible convenience and selection to our customers.

Working at Deliveroo is the perfect environment to build an engineering career, driven by impact. Firstly, the impact that working here will have on your development, allowing you to grow faster than you might elsewhere; secondly, the impact that you can have on Deliveroo, leaving your mark as we scale; and finally, being part of something bigger, through the impact that we make together in our marketplace and communities.

The Role

Working as part of our analytics engineering team and reporting to one of our Analytics Engineering Managers, your role will be to provide clean, tested, well-documented and well-modelled data sets, that will enable and empower data scientists and business users alike, via tools like Snowflake and/or Looker.

  • You'll work with product engineering teams to ensure modelling of source data meets downstream requirements.
  • You will maintain and develop SQL data transformation scripts, and advise and review data scientists on data modelling to achieve denormalised and aggregated output datasets.
  • You'll work with data scientists and other analytics engineers to surface clean, intuitive datasets in our BI tool, Looker.
  • You will be responsible for optimisation and further adoption of Looker as a data product in the business, catering to ~1500 current active users who need to discover and interact with data.

 

Skillset

Required

  • 6+ years Analytics Engineering / Data Engineering / BI Engineering experience
  • Excellent SQL skills
  • Understanding of data warehousing, data modelling concepts and structuring new data tables
  • Knowledge of cloud-based MPP data warehousing (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)

Nice to have

  • Experience developing in a BI tool (Looker or similar)
  • Good practical understanding of version control
  • SQL ETL/ELT knowledge, experience with DAGs to manage script dependencies
  • Python coding skills, particularly in the areas of automation & integrations
  • Good knowledge of the Looker API

Workplace & Diversity

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. We offer multiple great benefits in areas including health, family, finance, community, convenience, growth and relocation.

We believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest growing start-ups around.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

In this role you will:

·        Effectively communicate results and provide support to ensure informed senior management decisions and that financial impacts are understood by all internal and external stakeholders.

·        Experience in preparing investment analysis, presentations and decision papers and presenting those to relevant internal and external stakeholders.

Care for each other and our world – we leave egos at the door, are inclusive, collaborative and open to new ideas 

A spirit of ingenuity - we are pioneers and innovators making the impossible possible 

A commitment to unlocking value from offshore wind – we aim to make offshore wind sustainable, affordable and accessible to the countries & communities we serve. 

 

About JERA Nex bp 

JERA Nex bp is a purpose-built offshore wind company committed to unlocking the power of offshore wind by developing high-quality, competitive projects. 

A 50:50 joint venture between JERA Co. and bp, JERA Nex bp is an end-to-end developer, owner and operator with more than fifteen years of experience in operating offshore wind projects.  

Headquartered in London, with offices across Europe, Asia, and Australia, JERA Nex bp has a portfolio of operational and development projects across nine countries, and draws on a rich heritage of pioneering offshore wind in Asia Pacific and the North Sea.

jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer (Internship)
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a six-month internship based in Munich or Cologne. This is an in-person role. You learn this job by sitting next to people who already do it, and that does not work remotely.

About the role

Think of this role as the modern Sherlock Holmes — new puzzles to solve and new people to work with, every single day.
This role sits exactly at the intersection of technology and business, and that is not a figure of speech. On one side you are in the system, in the data, working out what actually happened. On the other you are on a call with a finance team explaining it and agreeing what to do. You need both, every day.

Our customers run their finance and supply chain processes on blp. When something does not behave the way they expected, a document that did not post, an exception that should have resolved itself, a number in a dashboard that looks wrong, they write to us. That is where your work starts, and it is also where you become the face of blp for that customer. What reaches them is you: your answer, your explanation, your judgement about what to do next.

You will not be reading from a script and escalating. You investigate what the system did, what the data says and what the customer's process actually requires. You have the access and the authority to change configuration when that is the answer. And when it is not, you know who to bring in and what to give them.

The role grows with you. You start on cases where the pattern is known and someone is close by. As your expertise builds you take the harder ones, and your exposure to customers grows with it: from written answers, to calls, to being in the room when a customer wants their most pressing problem solved now.

This goes well beyond tickets. We are a fast-moving organisation and a lot of what needs to exist does not exist yet. You will take on and drive initiatives that make the whole operation scale: a recurring problem that should be solved once rather than fifty times, a piece of tooling that does not exist, a way of working that has outgrown itself. Interns here have shipped things that the team still uses.

How we think about ownership
You will be given real work with real consequences, early, because that is the only way anyone learns this job properly. The other half of that is judgement: explore and decide for yourself where you can, and pull someone in when something critical is on the line. Knowing which situation you are in is part of the skill, and nobody will hold it against you for asking. What matters is that you are the face of blp to that customer, and that you take that seriously.

Most of our customers work in German and you will be in front of them from early on. That is uncomfortable for about three weeks and then it is the best part of the job.

This is a real internship, not an observation post. You will be trusted with live customers quickly, with people close by while you learn.

What you'll do

  • Answer incoming customer requests through our support channel, and be the person they hear back from.

  • Own incidents end to end: investigate, resolve, and confirm with the customer that it is actually fixed.

  • Work out why a workflow, document or posting did not behave as expected.

  • Adjust configuration where that is the right fix.

  • Recognise when a problem is bigger than one case, and hand it on with proper evidence.

  • Join customer calls to work through urgent issues directly, as your experience grows.

  • Take on initiatives beyond the queue: things that should be fixed once rather than answered repeatedly.

  • Document what you learn so the next person does not have to learn it twice.

What we're really looking for

We do not expect you to know ERP systems. We expect you to be the kind of person who gets to the bottom of things.

  • Curiosity – You want to know why something works, not just that it does.

  • Clear Logic – You take a messy situation apart, find the actual cause, and explain it simply.

  • Customer Nerve – You stay calm and credible with a frustrated controller on the phone, and you can say "I do not know yet, here is how I will find out."

  • Self-Driven – You close your own knowledge gaps without being told to.

  • Ownership – You see things through without someone checking, and you know when to pull someone in.

What you'll bring

  • Enrolled in or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's in business, economics, information systems, engineering, computer science, or something adjacent. Strong candidates from other backgrounds are welcome to make their case.

  • German and English, both fluent. This is a hard requirement. Our customers work in German every day and our internal work runs in English.

  • Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with data.

  • Genuine interest in enterprise software, AI, and how large organisations actually run.

  • Nice to have, not required: first exposure to ERP systems, SQL, APIs, or process modelling.

Where it leads

Our internship is the main entry point into the delivery organisation. Interns who do well are offered a permanent role, most often as a Customer Success Engineer or as an AI Automation Specialist, and from there the paths into Consulting and into project management are well travelled. We tell you early and honestly whether that conversation is coming.

What you'll get

  • Real responsibility from week three, not shadowing.

  • A steep learning curve on live enterprise systems.

  • Direct access to engineers, product managers, and the people running our customers' finance operations.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option programme.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Visits & offsites – including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

jobs.description:
Wir suchen

...Dich als Werkstudent:in im Bereich Customer Success (w/m/d). Du unterstützt unsere Kund:innen beim Remote-Onboarding ihrer smarten Energiegeräte und sorgst dafür, dass alles reibungslos läuft. Dabei kannst du deine Leidenschaft für User Experience und kund:innenzentrierte Kommunikation einbringen – in einem Team, das zusammen stärker ist und jeden Tag besser werden will.


Wenn Du daran Spaß hast

  • Als Werkstudent:in im Technical Support übernimmst du einen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich rund um unseren Energiemanager, bearbeitest technische Supportfälle zu Konnektivität, Betriebsweise, Wärmepumpensteuerung, PV- und Batteriesystemen eigenständig und eskalierst nur klar definierte Fälle an den 3rd Level.
  • Du analysierst und diagnostizierst technische Fehlerbilder, wertest Anlagendaten und Logs aus und dokumentierst die Ursachen nachvollziehbar im Ticket.
  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für einen definierten Self-Service-Bereich: Du identifizierst wiederkehrende Fälle, entwickelst AI-gestützte Fall Klassifikationen, geprüfte Inhalte und Agenten-Workflows und misst deren Wirkung.
  • Du pflegst die Salesforce Knowledge Base in Abstimmung mit dem Customer Experience Team und unterstützt interne Kolleg:innen bei technischen Rückfragen zu den Systemen.
  • Du meldest wiederkehrende Fehlerbilder regelmäßig an Produktmanagement und Engineering, gibst eigene Priorisierungsempfehlungen ab und hinterfragst Support- und Dokumentationsprozesse vom First Principle her, um sie mit KI-Werkzeugen neu zu gestalten und umzusetzen.


Und Dich hier wiedererkennst

  • Laufendes Studium, mindestens im 3. Semester, idealerweise in Elektrotechnik, Informationstechnik, Energietechnik, Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang wie BWL oder Innovationsmanagement. Du bist über die gesamte Laufzeit immatrikuliert.
  • Technische Praxiserfahrung: Erste Erfahrung durch ein Praktikum, eine Werkstudententätigkeit, eine Ausbildung oder eigene technische Projekte. Erfahrung im Support- oder Energieumfeld ist von Vorteil.
  • Energiesysteme: Technisches Grundverständnis für Wärmepumpen, PV, Batteriespeicher und Energiemanagement sowie die Bereitschaft, dich tief einzuarbeiten.
  • Fehleranalyse und Daten: Du bildest Hypothesen, prüfst sie strukturiert, wertest Tabellen und Logs aus und dokumentierst Ergebnisse nachvollziehbar. 
  • Kommunikation und Systeme: Du kannst technische Sachverhalte verständlich und fehlerfrei in Guides, FAQs und Serviceartikeln erklären und gehst sicher mit CRM- und Ticket-Systemen um. Salesforce ist von Vorteil.
  • AI- und First-Principle-Erfahrung: Du hast LLMs über die reine Chatnutzung hinaus eingesetzt, zum Beispiel für Prompting, Automatisierungen, Agenten-Workflows oder die Anbindung an Tools und Daten, und denkst Prozesse von ihren Grundbestandteilen her neu.
  • Arbeitsweise: Du verfügst über eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und hohe Lernbereitschaft, treibst eigene Themen selbstständig voran, hältst Ergebnisse nach und arbeitest zuverlässig und verbindlich mit Kund:innen und internen Teams zusammen.


Was wir Dir bieten

  • Deine Leistung verdient Anerkennung, daher verdienst du bei uns ab 15 Euro pro Stunde.
  • Einen Job mit Sinn, einer klaren Vision und der seltenen Gelegenheit, mit einem der größten CleanTechs Deutschlands aktiv mitzugestalten.
  • Eine Unternehmenskultur, die Menschen quer durch die Gesellschaft zusammenbringt – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter oder Hintergrund.
  • Ein modernes Office mitten in Berlin-Kreuzberg mit Dachterrasse, in dem auch Hunde willkommen sind.
  • Arbeite flexibel im Mobile Office und mindestens einen Tag im Büro.
  • Monatliche Unternehmensevents wie Lunch & Learn und Drinks & Action.
  • Bilde Dich weiter! Regelmäßige Möglichkeiten für Trainings und Fortbildungen durch unser eigenes Learning & Development Team oder externe Coaches.
  • Corporate Benefits: Mitarbeiterrabatte bei über 100 Partner:innen.


Über uns

Jede Bewerbung ist willkommen bei uns - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter, sexueller Orientierung oder Identität. Wir sind überzeugt, jeder Mensch ist wertvoll und verdient eine faire Chance.

Kein Haus gleicht dem anderen, aber für jeden von uns ist es ein Zuhause. Es steht für das, was uns ausmacht, was uns wichtig ist. Hier wollen wir seit jeher geborgen, sicher und ungestört sein.

Aber wir glauben, beim eigenen Heim geht es künftig um mehr - nämlich um die Generationen, die nach uns kommen. Wir glauben, unsere Häuser können mehr! Sie können elektrifiziert, intelligent, effizient, unabhängig und klimaneutral sein. Wir glauben, klimaneutrales Wohnen sollte für jeden zugänglich, erschwinglich und einfach sein. Und mit jeder Wärmepumpe vor unseren Häusern, jeder Photovoltaikanlage auf unseren Dächern und jeder Wallbox in unseren Garagen leisten wir einen Beitrag für klimaneutrales Wohnen.

Wir glauben nicht nur an klimaneutrales Wohnen – wir ermöglichen es.
Für Millionen von Eigenheimen. Gemeinsam. Jeden Tag. Heim für Heim.


Dein Bewerbungsprozess

  • Überzeugt Dein CV? Dann gehst Du mit Vanessa (Talent Acquisition Managerin) in einen ersten Austausch.
  • Passt es weiterhin? Bekommst Du die Möglichkeit, eine Case Study durchzuführen.
  • Besteht von beiden Seiten Interesse, steigst Du mit René (Senior Product Manager) und Lucas (Senior Product Manager) tiefer in die Position ein.
  • Sind alle glücklich? Herzlich willkommen bei thermondo.


Los geht's

Das ist genau die Herausforderung, nach der Du suchst? Dann warte nicht länger und bewirb Dich bei uns. Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
Regional Operations Director
Senior Backend Engineer - Payment Squad
jobs.description:
About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely.


Your Mission

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Payment Squad. They manage BlaBlaCar’s payment solutions that provide reliability, trust, and a smooth end-to-end experience.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, your role will be to drive the delivery of a reliable and scalable platform that supports the full payment lifecycle, fraud fight, and compliance requirements. You will take ownership of complex, cross-functional projects—such as finalizing the implementation of our payment orchestrator—and play a key role in expanding BlaBlaCar's business by proposing and integrating tailored payment methods for our various operational countries.

You will act as a technical reference, demonstrating strong autonomy, deep architectural thinking, and the ability to synchronize with multiple external teams (Legal, Cash Management & Finance, Payment Ops).

You will be reporting to the squad's Engineering Manager and working closely with a team of Software Engineers and a Product Manager.




Your responsibilities
  • Drive and deliver transverse and complex technical projects from design to deployment, demonstrating a deep understanding of technical constraints and implementation challenges.
  • Lead the finalization and scaling of the payment orchestrator and integrate new, adapted payment methods across different countries.
  • Take a step back to proactively propose platform improvements, task automation, and better observability (e.g., establishing SLO reviews with SREs and owning your monitoring and alerting stack).
  • Interact closely with various teams (Legal, Finance, Fraud/Payment Ops) to synchronize efforts, gather requirements, and assess cross-team impacts.
  • Act as a mentor and guide for mid-level (IC3) developers within the squad, elevating the team's overall engineering standards.
  • Participate in a cyclic on-call duty (approximately 1 week every 7 weeks) to ensure the high availability of our critical payment systems.

    • Your qualifications
  • You have 5 to 10 years of overall engineering experience.
  • You possess deep technical autonomy and a high level of critical thinking regarding software architecture and constraints.
  • You are fluent in Java and have advanced knowledge of frameworks such as Spring, or SpringBoot.
  • You have hands-on experience with service-oriented architectures, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, and monitoring solutions (Datadog).
  • You have excellent, clear, and concise communication skills, allowing you to easily step into any workshop and share technical expertise with both technical and business stakeholders.
  • You are not reluctant to participate in on-call duties (mandatory for this role).
  • Full working proficiency in English
  • Fit with our BlaBlaPrinciples
    • If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, tell us why you’d still be a great fit for this role in your application.

    What we have to offer
  • Hybrid position
  • 4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves
  • 50% healthcare coverage (Alan)
  • Financial support for home office equipment
  • Minimum 25 days holiday per year
  • Local meal plan policy (Swile card)
  • 50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)
  • Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides
  • Personal growth via trainings, mentorship, and internal mobility programs
  • Employee Stock ownership plan
  • Regular team building events
  • 1 day off per year to test our product

    • Interested in joining the ride?
    • a 45-min video-call with a Talent Acquisition Manager, to get to know you, understand your career expectations and answer your questions

    • a 90-min live coding session with Software Engineers

    • a 60-min design interview with Software Engineers

    • a 60-min video-call with Julien, Engineering Manager of the payment team, to discuss your experience, and share more details about the squad.

    Our hiring process lasts on average 25-30 days, offers usually come within 48 hours.

    BlaBlaCar is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
